Supabase JavaScript SDK 2.119.1, bundled locally for the browser.
Rebuild with npm ci and npm run vendor.
Included packages: @supabase/auth-js, @supabase/functions-js, @supabase/phoenix, @supabase/postgrest-js, @supabase/realtime-js, @supabase/storage-js, @supabase/supabase-js, iceberg-js, tslib.
Licenses are retained in licenses/. No server secret or service-role key is bundled.
